newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst board member to join Clariant.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst board member to join Clariant.

text.p: German chemicals group Hoechst AG on Tuesday said one of its board members would resign after the portfolio of businesses he was responsible for had been partly sold off.
Karl-Gerhard Seifert, the board member in charge of specialty chemicals and diagnostics, will leave the board and join Swiss group Clariant AG in July, Hoechst said in a statement.

Hoechst sold its specialty chemicals group to Clariant last December, retaining a minority stake in the Swiss group. Hoechst also plans to spin off the diagnostics group but plans to initially keep the business as part of a joint-venture.

As the Hoechst supervisory board also agreed to transform the group into a strategic management holding group, requiring a smaller board, sources close to Hoechst said Seifert's position would likely not be filled by someone new.
